source: metadata.provider.plex.tv/library/streams/matches asked directly with an X-Plex-Token, the request a claimed PMS makes (plex_search_apply_s143.json's outbound) with one parameter left out at a time
note: Token and headers left out. A search with no guid is answered: the guid only narrows it. A search with no openSubtitlesHash is refused with 400, guid or not: rex sends none when it cannot read the Part's head and tail (no size pushed, or the source refuses the Range), as an item from a source like rex-youtube can be. Every search plexlab's PMS sent from 2026-09-12 to 2026-11-04 (21, capture/outbound.jsonl) carried a plex:// guid and came from a Search Subtitles request or a probe; it sent none on its own.
